notes: Create a separate Google Cloud project for Fakturasjekk; never reuse another application's project or credentials.
Prefer keyless federation when a verified Supabase Edge workload-identity design is available.
The service-account JSON fallback must exist only in a server-side secret store and must never be committed or published.
IAM must be validated against the actual APIs before live; do not grant broad Owner/Editor roles to the runtime identity.
